correctness.rationale: Every edge is special, inradius=1/2 and overlap side length c=tan(pi/N). The source first and third sufficient bounds specialize to A(lambda)=(1-lambda)s and B(lambda)=[1-sqrt(1-lambda^2 tan^2(pi/N))]/2, decreasing and increasing, respectively. Equality yields (1+4s-4s^2)u^2+(4s-6)u+1=0 with u=1-lambda, discriminant 32(1-s)^2 and unique admissible root. The fourth source bound >=tan^2(pi/N)/2 exceeds su because u<1/2; second vacuous. Primary source explicitly permits side-normal width instead of diameter. The analytic argument establishes every even N>=6; finite sweep is supplementary, and delta is not claimed truly optimal for Bezdek annulus.
